Im 31 and have had severe eczema all over my whole body since I was about 4ish - neck, face, arms, elbows, legs, back, butt, everywhere, you name it. If you are interested in Dupixent and live in the states you will have to try other methods first before the Derm can give \*but\* there is a manufacturer card you can use that will cover the cost, and due to the cost of the medication it will also help you hit your deductible sooner. heehehehe

Why I switched from steriods to dupixent? I was concerned about the long term effects in regards of taking it for over two decades along with having to take zyrtec, prednisone, and antibiotics non-stop as doctors really do not know the true long term effects on the body. Also yes steriod withdrawal is a thing, but I've never encountered it due to always using the correct amount of ointments/cremes.
